acquisition method: using a repetitively full MS scan followed by high collision dissociation (HCD) of the ten most dominant ions selected from the first MS scan
alkylation reagent: modified with 10 mM iodoacetamide in 100 mM ammonium bicarbonate
alkylation concentration: modified with 10 mM iodoacetamide in 100 mM ammonium bicarbonate
cleavage agent: digested in 10% acetonitrile and 10 mM ammonium bicarbonate with modified trypsin (Promega)
enrichment method: Proteins were isolated using anti-Flag M2 beads as described above
fragmentation method: followed by high collision dissociation (HCD) of the ten most dominant ions
instrument: Mass spectrometry was performed by Q Exactive plus mass spectrometer (Thermo)
ionization type: Mass spectrometry was performed by Q Exactive plus mass spectrometer (Thermo) in a positive mode
labeling: Semi-quantitation was done by calculating the peak area of each peptide based on its extracted ion currents (XICs)
reduction reagent: The sample was reduced with 3 mM DTT (60 °C for 30 min)
reduction concentration: The sample was reduced with 3 mM DTT (60 °C for 30 min)
